paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: The training record of reward modeling. From the left to right, we present the records of training loss, gradient norm, and the learning rate, respectively.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the training loss of a reward model across varying training steps. The x-axis is labeled "Training Step", uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0 to 1400 with tick marks at intervals of 200 steps. The y-axis is labeled "Training Loss". It also uses a linear scale, and spans from 0.3 to 0.8, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. A single line is present in the plot, depicted in blue with a solid line style and no markers. At the start of the x-axis at 0, the line begins at a training loss slightly above 0.75. As the training steps increase, the line exhibits a sharp decline initially, reaching a value of approximately 0.35 around 200 steps. Beyond this point, the line continues to decrease more gradually, demonstrating minor fluctuations while maintaining an overall downward trend, settling around a value close to 0.3 by the end of the x-axis at 1400 steps. There is a legend at the top right of the plot to label the line.
